metadata.title: UPI Fraud - Fake QR Code
metadata.summary: Fraudster placed counterfeit QR code sticker over legitimate merchant QR at Aurangabad. QR appeared authentic with proper merchant branding. User scanned what appeared to be genuine merchant QR code for bill payment. No suspicion raised as QR was positioned at official payment counter. QR redirected payment to fraudster UPI ID instead of merchant account. 54,401 transferred instantly without merchant knowledge.

Message included order details and promised instant refund processing. User approved collect request believing it was incoming refund. Actually authorized 31,173 outgoing payment to fraudster account.

metadata.title: Credit Card Fraud - Vishing (Voice Phishing)
metadata.summary: Fraudster called posing as bank security officer reporting suspicious transactions on victim's credit card from different city. Caller knew partial card details and recent transaction history. Created urgency claiming card was compromised and being misused. Convinced user to share CVV and OTP for "security verification." Used details for unauthorized online purchases worth 99,895.

metadata.title: ATM Fraud - Card Skimming
metadata.summary: Fraudster installed card skimming device and hidden camera at busy ATM location during low-traffic hours. No direct user interaction required. Victim used ATM normally, unaware of data capture devices masquerading as ATM components. Skimmer captured card data, camera recorded PIN. Fraudster created cloned card and withdrew 25,046 from multiple ATMs.

Platform showed fake portfolio growth before becoming inaccessible.

Took life insurance policy with fraudster as beneficiary, then accelerated death through medical negligence to claim 4,793,148.

metadata.title: Digital Wallet Fraud - SIM Swap Attack
metadata.summary: Obtained victim's personal details through data breach, then manipulated telecom employee to issue duplicate SIM card. No direct victim interaction. Fraudster impersonated victim at telecom store using stolen identity documents. With cloned SIM, intercepted OTPs for digital wallets and banking apps, transferring 98,540 to multiple accounts rapidly.
